a cycle of ten patterns, taught sixty times
settings            segments  named per step
plain               290       10
pooling, window 1   490       20
pooling, window 5   580       28

two sequences that share a pattern, followed into an input
only the other one contains
re-play window      active cells  named
ten steps           10            10
none                80            10

the re-play does not find more of the next pattern here - the
same ten nodes either way. What it keeps is the state: ten cells
rather than a burst of eighty, and a precise state is what a
pooled union is built from.
